item.description: The receive_messages method in SubprocessCLITransport is not properly implementing the async iterator protocol. Tests fail with "TypeError: 'async for' requires an object with __aiter__ method, got coroutine" because the method is returning a coroutine instead of properly yielding values in an async iterator.
item.contract: The receive_messages method must implement the AsyncIterator protocol correctly by: 1. Properly yielding JSON message dictionaries asynchronously 2. Returning an AsyncIterator[dict[str, Any]] as declared in the type hints 3. Not returning a coroutine when called by async for loops 4. Maintaining proper async resource lifecycle management
item.acceptance: The following tests should pass after the fix: - tests/test_streaming_client.py::TestClaudeSDKClientStreaming::test_receive_messages - tests/test_streaming_client.py::TestClaudeSDKClientStreaming::test_concurrent_send_receive - tests/test_streaming_client.py::TestClaudeSDKClientEdgeCases::test_receive_response_list_comprehension - tests/test_integration.py::TestIntegration::test_simple_query_response - tests/test_integration.py::TestIntegration::test_continuation_option - tests/test_integration.py::TestIntegration::test_query_with_tool_use - tests/test_client.py::TestQueryFunction::test_query_with_cwd
